pages.title: Ingredient Calculator - Scale Recipes, Convert Units & Find Substitutions
pages.meta_description: Free ingredient calculator to scale recipes to any serving size, convert cooking units (cups, grams, oz, mL), find ingredient substitutions, and estimate nutrition. Fast, accurate, no signup required.

pages.title: Cups to Grams Converter - Accurate Cooking Measurement Conversion
pages.meta_description: Free cups to grams converter for cooking and baking. Convert cups to grams for flour, sugar, butter, rice, and 50+ ingredients. Accurate measurements for perfect recipes every time.

pages.title: Recipe Unit Converter - Convert Between US, Metric & Imperial Measurements
pages.meta_description: Free recipe unit converter. Convert between cups, grams, ounces, milliliters, tablespoons, teaspoons, Fahrenheit, Celsius and more. US, metric, and imperial cooking measurements.

pages.title: Serving Size Calculator - Scale Recipes for Any Number of Guests
pages.meta_description: Free serving size calculator. Scale any recipe from any number of servings to any other. Party planning mode for 25, 50, 100+ guests. Calculate exact ingredient amounts.

pages.title: Egg Substitute Calculator - Find the Best Egg Replacement for Baking
pages.meta_description: Free egg substitute calculator for baking. Find the perfect egg replacement — flax eggs, applesauce, banana, aquafaba, and more. Vegan and allergy-friendly options with exact measurements.

pages.title: Baking Ratios Calculator - Classic Baking Formulas by Weight
pages.meta_description: Free baking ratios calculator. Scale classic baking formulas — pound cake, cookie dough, pie crust, bread, biscuits and more. Enter total weight and get exact ingredient amounts.
